blockers.description: All provider-required subjects remain blocked until exact document bytes, per-page slicing, and build replay are closed.
pymatgen wrapper 2026.5.4 and pymatgen-core 2026.5.18 identities remain intentionally unresolved rather than merged.

declared_scope.statement: ASE documented capability for supercell, site-lineage with its declared API, units, invariants, and failure boundary.
ASE documented capability for vacancy, substitution, manual-defect with its declared API, units, invariants, and failure boundary.
ASE documented capability for slab, surface, adsorbate with its declared API, units, invariants, and failure boundary.
ASE documented capability for read, write, format-conversion, round-trip with its declared API, units, invariants, and failure boundary.
ASE documented capability for wrap, periodic-images with its declared API, units, invariants, and failure boundary.
Deterministic audit of structure identity, periodicity, coordinates, occupancy, symmetry, charge, and spin.
Non-executing QE, VASP, CP2K, or SIESTA structure export plan.
Distribution-metadata probe that does not import or execute optional providers.
Deterministic representation and periodic-equivalence round-trip classification.
Candidate-local reorder transform with complete site mapping.
Candidate-local diagonal supercell transform with parent-child identity.
Candidate-local wrap transform with explicit image-shift lineage.
The Skill remains development, non-routable, and capped at no_positive_claim.
pymatgen-core documented capability for ase-conversion, structure-conversion, molecule-conversion with its declared API, units, invariants, and failure boundary.
pymatgen-core documented capability for vacancy, manual-defect with its declared API, units, invariants, and failure boundary.
pymatgen-core documented capability for supercell, site-lineage, charge-boundary with its declared API, units, invariants, and failure boundary.
pymatgen-core documented capability for molecule, periodic-box, embedding with its declared API, units, invariants, and failure boundary.
pymatgen-core documented capability for slab, termination, adsorption-sites, adsorbate with its declared API, units, invariants, and failure boundary.
pymatgen-core documented capability for symmetry, primitive-standardization, conventional-standardization with its declared API, units, invariants, and failure boundary.
pymatgen-core documented capability for read, write, serialization, round-trip with its declared API, units, invariants, and failure boundary.
RDKit documented capability for hydrogen-addition, 3d-embedding, conformer-generation, force-field-optimization with its declared API, units, invariants, and failure boundary.
RDKit documented capability for molecule-read, sanitization, formal-charge with its declared API, units, invariants, and failure boundary.
RDKit documented capability for molecule-write, conformer-export, round-trip with its declared API, units, invariants, and failure boundary.
Occupancy, site identity, symmetry provenance, charge/spin, mapping, round-trip, and target-code choices remain separate scientific readiness gates.
spglib 2.7.0 Python symmetry-dataset and explicit-tolerance review surface, retained as reference-only rather than an active adapter.
